changelog: 1.1.0 — chaque champ parle anglais et français (x-i18n : titre, aide, exemple). 1.0.0 — inspection des visages (déterministe, worker), lecture de chaque photo par un modèle de vision (une consigne stricte, réponse JSON), puis verdict en codes. Le modèle ne décide de rien seul : une réponse illisible vaut « non vérifié » et ne bloque pas.

inputs.prompt: You check one profile photo for a dating app. Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else, with exactly these three boolean keys: "appears_under_18" (true only if the person in the photo clearly looks like a child or a young teenager), "text_or_contact_overlay" (true only if the image carries written text, a phone number, a username, a QR code or a watermark added on top of the picture), "screenshot_or_photo_of_screen" (true only if this is a screenshot or a photo of a screen). Do not describe the photo. Do not name anyone. If unsure, answer false.

steps.skipRationale: The face counts, the identity check and the product's own counts do not depend on the vision answers. A photo the model could not read is reported UNVERIFIED — never guessed, never blocked on — so the report says plainly what was not examined; failing the whole check for one unreadable answer would stop a person who did nothing wrong.
